title: AntSeed · Work + Sales CRM
narration: AntSeed connects work, sales, and conversation evidence. This tour uses real company records.

title: 01 / Work Kanban
narration: The actual Vikunja board tracks six work stages, from To be started through Completed. Company cards carry the next action in their title. Workstreams classify the relationship separately. This is a read only recording from the running platform.

title: 02 / Company card & next action
narration: Open a company card to see its structured context: company, conversation, current stage, workstream, and the next action for AntSeed. Further sections hold contacts, tasks, deadlines, blockers, and source references. Our responsibilities stay separate from external commitments. Missing dates are shown as unknown, rather than invented.

title: 03 / Sales CRM
narration: The real outreach dashboard organizes relationships into Lead or Prospect, Qualification, Negotiation, Deal Won, and Archived. Phala and Fere AI sit in Qualification in this saved evidence. Commercial discussions appear separately in Negotiation. There are no evidenced wins or archive decisions here. These are sales classifications, not replacements for the operational work lanes.

title: 05 / Telegram intake & approvals
narration: The live control settings show an approval group already connected. New group intake and later work stage proposals can be reviewed through Telegram. Historical inclusion is managed separately. This recording only inspects these controls. It sends no approval and moves no live deal. The control group remains excluded from business analysis.
